content: GitLab employees in the Philippines are entitled to up to 105 days of maternity leave, with the option for 30 additional unpaid days (or 45 extra days for solo mothers) [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > **Philippines 🇵🇭**]
- **Maternity:** Up to 105 days, with option for 30 additional unpaid days (45 extra days for solo mothers)
- **Paternity:** Up to 7 days, extendable to 14 days if spouse allocates additional days
- **Payment:** Social Security System provides base payments; GitLab supplements to 100% for up to 16 weeks if eligible
- Please familiarize yourself with [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

**How to Apply**
Submit requests via [Workday - Time Off](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZatJdGp485lOS2QVrxYJByQK8dD_CMGiLVOykgd338w/edit) at least 30 days before leave starts.

[2] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Maternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Team members must have continuous employment with GitLab for at least 26 weeks leading up to the "qualifying week" (15th week before the expected week of childbirth)
- Up to 52 weeks leave available
- First 39 weeks paid (combining statutory and GitLab benefits)
- 90% of average earnings for first 6 weeks (before tax), then statutory rate (£194.32/week) or 90% (whichever is lower) of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for the next 33 weeks. This also applies to the leave amounts provided for Parental Leave and Adoption Leave.
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary

How to Apply

[3] [GitLab GK (Japan) Benefits > Health & Wellbeing Benefits > Family & Life Transition Support]
Maternity Leave & Benefits

**Overview**

Take 14 weeks of protected maternity leave with two-thirds of your base salary through government allowance.

**Eligibility**

- All pregnant GitLab GK team members
- Available regardless of employment length

**Key Features**

Leave starts 6 weeks before due date. Government provides 2/3 salary during entire leave period.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Leave begins 6 weeks before delivery
2. **Apply**: Submit government allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Work with manager and People Operations

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Parental Leave (Child Care Leave)

**Overview**

Take up to one year of protected leave with substantial government financial support.

**Eligibility**

- Available until child's first birthday
- Fixed-term employees need one year employment
- Must commit to return to work

**Key Features**

Receive 67% salary (first 6 months), 50% thereafter. Both parents can take leave.

**How to Access**

1. **Plan**: Starts after maternity leave (mothers) or from birth (fathers)
2. **Apply**: Submit allowance application
3. **Coordinate**: Arrange role coverage

**Important Information**

- May coordinate with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/) if eligible

Additional Family Support

**Child Nursing Care Leave**: Up to 5 days (1 child) or 10 days (2+ children). Runs with GitLab PTO.

[4] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Maternity Leave]
GitLab provides comprehensive maternity leave support that goes beyond statutory requirements.  

Statutory Entitlement

- 26 weeks ordinary maternity leave  
- Additional 16 weeks unpaid leave available  
- Must start 2 weeks before due date  
- Minimum 4 weeks after birth

  

GitLab Support

- 100% salary for up to 16 weeks (includes state benefit top-up)  
- State Maternity Benefit: €262/week (subject to PRSI)  
- Support throughout your leave journey

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com with start/end dates
2. Receive completed MB2 form from Absence Management
3. Apply via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/apply-for-maternity-benefit/) at least 6 weeks before leave
4. Submit time off in Workday (Parental Leave category)

[5] [GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves]
GitLab Singapore combines statutory leave with our global parental leave policy to provide comprehensive support for growing families.

Team members employed for at least 3 months before birth may be eligible for the maternity leaves listed below.

Government-Paid Maternity Leave (16 weeks)

- **1st and 2nd births**: 8 weeks employer-paid + 8 weeks government-paid
- **3rd+ births**: 16 weeks government-paid
- First 8 weeks must be continuous; remaining weeks flexible within 12 months of birth
- Eligible team members receive concurrent [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)

Employment Act Maternity Leave (12 weeks)

- 8 weeks paid + 4 weeks unpaid
- With [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave), eligible team members receive up to 16 weeks paid

How to Apply

1. Submit "Parental Leave" request in Workday at least 30 days before leave
2. Send [GPML Declaration Form](https://file.go.gov.sg/gpml1form.pdf) to leaves@gitlab.com
3. GitLab handles government reimbursement claims

[6] [Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave]
*GitLab’s paid Parental Leave is available for any active team member (regardless of gender) who becomes a parent through childbirth or adoption while working at GitLab. The information in this section is specific to GitLab’s 16-week paid Parental Leave. Different countries or US states may provide team members with their own statutory Parental Leave benefits. Please review your [country/state](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#entity-specific-benefits) Parental Leave benefits for more information on how to apply and tenure requirements (if applicable).*

Question: How many days of maternity leave are available to a GitLab employee in the Philippines?
